verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents some versioning of its own: effort presets can be pinned to a dated release (e.g. `fast@2026-10-16.0`) so you keep one released configuration after the level moves on, and the API reference notes that Sonar requests are being migrated to the Agent API gradually by model. The evidence shows no formal deprecation policy, notice periods or sunset schedule, and no explicit API-version scheme beyond a `/v1` path. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines, an explicit API versioning and changelog scheme, and independent corroboration of version stability.
